method: Whole replay.c/h reads; Git blob verification, static analysis.
findings: Replay obtains fresh lstat but mtime check is optional when report field absent; provided time accepted within0.05seconds. Stored checksum reused without fresh content verification here.
Report device/inode values inserted into trie before current lstat; this function does not compare report identity to fresh identity. Other trie/caller effects still need runtime validation.

Checksum string duplicated directly from JSON and passed as external checksum; syntax, algorithm tag and expected digest length not validated here. Previously reviewed clustering can group by those strings.
Loader requires array root then assumes interior objects between header/footer; no local per-field JSON type schema or record-count/resource bound. Each record admission return value ignored.
Any successfully parsed array marks report valid even if every record rejected. Overall success is not proof all saved files admitted.
Empty-directory replay rechecks current emptiness, a stronger local gate than ordinary stored checksum reuse.
Duplicated checksum ownership is passed to traverse_file; if admission fails before model takes ownership no free is visible in replay. Runtime leak not measured.
limits: No original replay runtime or malformed-input controls executed.
No rrrah edits/tests; native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
